The agent passes its own model id. Static griffe diff of package sources: no model calls, no API key, no package code executed. Install: `uvx since-cutoff@latest mcp`; stdio; no auth. Clients: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI. Registry id `io.github.MohammadHijjawi97/since-cutoff`. MIT.

en.description: Nano (XNO) wallet as a local stdio MCP server, Python standard library only. Tools: `create_address`, `validate_address` (checksum-checked, returns a machine-readable reason), `balance`, `receive`, and `send` in the full profile. `--profile receive-only` does not register `send` at all (`-32601`), and `nano-wallet selfcheck --profile receive-only` proves that on the install it runs on. In the full profile `send` is refused unless `NANO_WALLET_ALLOW_SEND=1`, and can be bound to an operator-signed mandate (total cap, per-payment max, payee allow-list, expiry). Keys are generated and blocks signed locally; amounts are integer raw. Install: `pip install "git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/nano-wallet-xno"`, then run `mcp_server.py --profile receive-only`. MIT.

abilities.description: 面向学术诚信的可解释 AI 写作检测与原创性检查工具，支持英语与西班牙语。`analyze_ai_writing` 返回 0–100 的评分及背后的所有检测依据——过度使用的词汇、刻板的修辞套路、句法模式以及句子节奏突发性——每项均附带匹配文本与修改建议，而非不透明的黑盒百分比；它还主动公开自身的误报率，在 296 篇 2022 年前撰写的文本中仅误标 2 篇。`check_originality` 输出文档间的重合段落作为依据；`check_citations` 发现文档与其参考文献自相矛盾之处；`compare_to_baseline` 将文章与同一作者早期的作品进行比对；`inspect_characters` 排查不可见字符和形似字符；`write_report` 可将完整分析导出为可供提交给评审委员会的正式报告。除两项工具外，其余工具均完全在本地运行且文本绝不出境；两个依赖服务端的工具（困惑度、跨语言释义）会明确提示发送文本。stdio 传输，基于 .NET 10，MIT 许可证。安装方式：`dnx SignsOfAI.Mcp --yes` 或 `dotnet tool install --global SignsOfAI.Mcp`。浏览器在线演示：https://peopleworks.github.io/SignsofAI/

en.description: Explainable AI-writing detection and originality checking for academic integrity, in English and Spanish. `analyze_ai_writing` returns a 0–100 score plus every tell behind it — overused vocabulary, rhetorical crutches, syntactic patterns, and sentence-rhythm burstiness — each with the matched text and a fix, instead of a black-box percentage; it also publishes its own error rate rather than asking to be trusted, flagging 2 of 296 texts written before 2022. `check_originality` returns the shared passages between documents as evidence; `check_citations` finds where a document contradicts its own bibliography; `compare_to_baseline` sits a piece against the same writer's earlier work; `inspect_characters` surfaces invisible and lookalike characters; `write_report` exports the whole analysis as a document a person can take to a committee. Every tool but two runs entirely on the machine and the text never leaves it; the two server-backed ones (perplexity, cross-language paraphrase) disclose that they send text. stdio transport, .NET 10, MIT. Install: `dnx SignsOfAI.Mcp --yes`, or `dotnet tool install --global SignsOfAI.Mcp`. Browser demo: https://peopleworks.github.io/SignsofAI/
